display_long_description:
# 2-Player co-op: Turn Your Home into an Elven Watchtower and Defend the Realm! 🏹✨

Greetings, archer, and welcome to Elven Arrows, an auto-adaptive Mixed Reality game that transforms your entire room into a free-roam watchtower. Draw a real bow, walk freely around your space, and hold the sacred crystals against invaders determined to shatter them.

[media]
###
## **🔮 TRANSFORM YOUR SURROUNDINGS INTO A PLAYSPACE**

Elven Arrows scans your room the moment you start, then builds itself around your real walls and furniture.

[media]

Watch your surroundings morph into a watchtower: enchanted stone walls trace your physical room, your own furniture carried over into the realm.

[media]

###
## **⚡ BUILD YOUR RUN, WAVE BY WAVE**

After every wave you choose a new power, and no two runs come out the same. Around 40 augments cover crit and headshots, arrow stats, multi-shot, fire, arcane, lightning and traps, with rerolls.

Augments also raise four shrines in your room: Freeze, Nature, Storm and Meteor. Shoot one to trigger it.
###

## **Why "Elven Arrows" Will Enchant You**
- **🏠 Auto-Adaptive Mixed Reality:** Your living space morphs into a lofty tower overlooking the realm.
- **🏹 Explosive Elemental Arrows:** Light them at the fire torches on your wall and they explode on impact.
- **🐉 Dragon Boss Fights:** Hold out against the dragon that swoops in every few waves.
- **👥 2-Player co-op Fun:** Team up with 1 friend in the same room.
###

**More from 2Sync:**

- Mixed Snow Worlds
- The Last Galaxy
